areas.name: Windows Route and Save Archive

save_backup.title: Keep a protected manual branch
save_backup.why: Create the rotating save structure before the first city transition.
save_backup.detail: Retain the earlier slot until every entry in this section is checked.

point_of_no_return.title: Archive the current city state first

point_of_no_return.detail: Finish the local checklist and copy the save before agreeing to travel onward.

levels.1: Use the highest-fidelity official route.
levels.2: Play the native Windows edition; no secondary platform is needed.
levels.3: Install the current Windows build, choose a stable 16:9 capture resolution, record the storefront and patch, and keep a clean controller profile. The console editions add no separate completion content, so one PC archive covers the chosen route.

levels.1: Keep a file from every travel stop.
levels.2: Make a permanent save before leaving each city.
levels.3: Reserve separate slots for the current city, the previous city, the latest Jail checkpoint, and the post-clear state. Speak to every visible teammate, accept every local request, buy local recipes, and only then overwrite the rolling travel save.

levels.1: Friends may have work that the request menu does not add automatically.
levels.2: Walk the current streets and speak to every teammate before travel.
levels.3: Before selecting the next destination, tour every accessible street and beach, speak to each teammate, then compare the request menu against this pack's dated ledger. Complete every starred local errand before departing; the combat Jails remain revisitable, but city conversations do not.

levels.1: Each stop sells a few local records.
levels.2: Buy new recipes, ingredients, gifts, and decorations before departure.
levels.3: Inspect every storefront and vending machine in the current city. Purchase one copy of each new recipe, local ingredient, caravan decoration, and unique consumable; restock cheap cooking inputs after the purchases so the kitchen registry can be tested immediately.

levels.1: Frequent use unlocks each fighter's private techniques.
levels.2: Rotate every available fighter until all four Master Arts appear.
levels.3: Check Stats after every Jail visit and note each character's Master Art count. Put unfinished characters in the active party, control them during encounters, and continue until their fourth entry opens; progress carries into the next cycle.

levels.1: The last request opens a separate cycle option.
levels.2: Preserve a finished request file before starting another cycle.
levels.3: After clearing the late optional encounter and confirming the new-cycle prompt, save into a fresh slot. Keep the original completion file untouched so Merciless, ordinary New Game Plus, and any remaining request cleanup can be tested independently.

levels.1: The highest new-cycle setting cannot be lowered.
levels.2: Start Merciless only from a duplicated completion file.
levels.3: Duplicate the clear state, begin New Game Plus on Merciless from that copy, and confirm the warning before committing. Difficulty is fixed for that cycle; bring a strong registered Persona set, complete equipment, recovery stock, and a separate ordinary-cycle branch.

levels.1: Keep prompts consistent across the archive.
levels.2: Choose one controller layout before recording completion footage.
levels.3: Disable automatic prompt switching, test camera and lock-on sensitivity in the first safe combat space, and preserve the chosen layout in the archive notes. Translate combo notation through the in-game command list instead of relying on another platform's button labels.

levels.1: Watch balconies, roof edges, and side rooms.
levels.2: Open every ordinary and lock-rated chest in Shibuya.

levels.1: Let unfamiliar encounters reveal themselves.

levels.1: The stationary figure with electrical effects can wait.
levels.2: Return to Shibuya's conspicuous high-level shadow when prepared.
levels.3: Create a checkpoint save, equip resistance against the enemy's visible affinities, carry full recovery stock, and defeat Shibuya's Dire Shadow. Confirm its one-time reward on the ordinary file; repeat it on Merciless for the route's exclusive top-tier weapon reward.

levels.1: A late request will mark a stronger arena.
levels.2: Complete every powerful-shadow request routed through Shibuya.
levels.3: Accept the relevant Oracle request before entering Shibuya, follow its map marker rather than wandering into story rooms, exploit the listed elemental weakness, and verify that the defeated form becomes available for fusion. levels.1: Floating pickups matter after their matching request appears.
levels.2: Complete every junk delivery and shop-expansion request tied to Shibuya.
levels.3: Activate each local junk or equipment request, defeat strong encounters, and collect floating item cubes until the request counter fills. areas.name: Post-Route and New-Cycle Archive
areas.location_cue: The caravan, Velvet Room, request menu, revisitable combat spaces, and clear-data screen.
areas.note: Everything that remains after the ordinary route, including Merciless-exclusive equipment.

save_backup.title: Keep a protected manual branch
save_backup.why: Duplicate the completed file before selecting New Game Plus or Merciless.
save_backup.detail: Retain the earlier slot until every entry in this section is checked.

point_of_no_return.title: Archive the current city state first
point_of_no_return.why: Merciless cannot be lowered after its new cycle begins.
point_of_no_return.detail: Finish the local checklist and copy the save before agreeing to travel onward.

levels.1: Clear every open request before the final optional chain.
levels.2: Stamp all 81 request-ledger entries complete.
levels.3: Compare the menu against all eight request-ledger areas, revisit any combat-space task, and confirm that every city-only entry was handled on its departure save. Finish the powerful-shadow chain before expecting the final optional request.

levels.1: Return to every stationary electrical figure.
levels.2: Defeat one Dire Shadow in each combat space.
levels.3: Use the eight Jail ledgers to revisit every Dire Shadow. Defeat all eight on the ordinary file for their unique rewards, then repeat them on Merciless because that cycle assigns the ultimate weapon set to these encounters.

levels.1: Oracle's marked arenas form a late sequence.
levels.2: Finish every powerful-shadow request until the final one appears.
levels.3: Accept and report each marked powerful-shadow task in sequence. Each victory opens a fusion entry and may be required for the next request; do not search for the final optional encounter until all preceding reports are stamped complete.

levels.1: A late arena opens only after the powerful-shadow chain.
levels.2: Defeat the request target at the end of the Okinawa laboratory route.
levels.3: After every powerful-shadow request is reported, accept the final optional request, travel to the last room of the Okinawa laboratory combat space, make a checkpoint save, win the encounter, and return to the Velvet Room. Confirm that New Game Plus is now selectable.

levels.1: Save the completed state into a new slot.
levels.2: Create clear data after the final optional request.
levels.3: With all requests, recipes, registries, Master Arts, and BOND caps checked, save clear data separately. Reload the original once to verify it remains usable, then start a new cycle from the duplicate.

levels.1: Most growth records should survive the restart.
levels.2: Verify Personas, levels, Master Arts, BOND, money, items, and shops after restart.
levels.3: Begin New Game Plus from duplicated clear data. At the first available menus, compare character growth, registered Personas, Master Arts, BOND skills, currency, inventory, equipment, recipes, and Sophia's shop unlocks against the clear-file audit. Requests reset and must be tracked separately.

levels.1: The last fusion recipe appears only after restart.
levels.2: Fuse Lucifer during New Game Plus.
levels.3: Start a new cycle after the final optional request, return to the Velvet Room when fusion is available, assemble the required high-level ingredients, create Lucifer, and register it before dismissal.

levels.1: Commit only after duplicating clear data.
levels.2: Start and finish a New Game Plus cycle on Merciless.
levels.3: Select Merciless from a protected clear-data copy and accept the permanent difficulty warning. Use the inherited registry and equipment, rebuild the request chain, defeat every respawning Dire Shadow for its difficulty-exclusive weapon, and keep a separate ordinary-cycle file.

levels.1: Late repeatable fights give the strongest return.
levels.2: Raise the file's BOND level to 99 and fill every skill.
levels.3: Carry the completed BOND board into Merciless, repeat high-value late encounters and requests, spend points after every level, and continue until the file reads BOND 99 and all thirty skills show their true maximum.

levels.1: Unfinished fighters can continue in the next cycle.
levels.2: Verify four Master Arts for each of nine combat styles.
levels.3: Open Stats for every fighter and confirm four named Master Arts. If a row is short, control that character through dense repeatable encounters; finish battles rather than swapping immediately, then recheck after each session.

levels.1: One entry is exclusive to the new cycle.
levels.2: Register all 67 protagonist-usable Personas and audit the fixed party entries.
levels.3: Sort the compendium by Arcana and compare every row with this pack. Fuse request-gated entries after their marked encounters, create Lucifer in New Game Plus, register Arsène before consuming it, and inspect each party member's fixed Persona separately.

levels.1: Learning a recipe is only half the record.
levels.2: Own all 19 recipes and prepare one dish from each.
levels.3: Compare the kitchen menu against the nineteen-entry ledger, acquire missing regional or request recipes, buy ingredients, and cook every dish once. Keep one finished sample where practical so effects can be checked without losing the registry state.

levels.1: Every equipment and grocery request expands a tab.
levels.2: Verify all final shop tiers after reporting every request.
levels.3: Finish each Sophia weapon, armor, grocery, accessory, and item expansion request, then reopen every shop tab. Compare the final inventory with the equipment-family ledger and buy any unique row not already recorded.

levels.1: The highest cycle changes late enemy rewards.
levels.2: Collect every ultimate weapon from Merciless Dire Shadows.
levels.3: On the Merciless branch, revisit all eight Dire Shadows after they become accessible. They respawn on this setting; defeat the relevant encounter for each character's top weapon and verify all nine weapon families, including rewards supplied elsewhere in the late cycle.

levels.1: Finish with a menu-by-menu proof pass.
levels.2: Capture every completed registry and preserve both cycle branches.
levels.3: Record the request list, Persona compendium, each fighter's Stats page, complete BOND board, kitchen, equipment families, shop tabs, city decorations, clear-data prompt, and Merciless rewards. Retain both the ordinary clear file and the Merciless completion file.
